nodes.label: Pimpinan & Staf public profile page (leadership and staff of Academic Affairs, BAA UNJANI Cimahi)
nodes.rationale: Public-facing design mockup: breadcrumb Home > Profil > Pimpinan & Staf with hero title 'Pimpinan dan Staf Bidang Akademik', leadership profile cards (Kepala Bidang Akademik Dr. Ir. Hendra Gunawan, Kepala Urusan Administrasi Akademik Dra. Siti Rahmawati) with photos, NIDN/NIP, job descriptions, email and building/room info; a filterable staff grid of 8 staff members grouped by role tags (Administrasi & Registrasi, Kurikulum & Evaluasi, Sistem & Data) each with photo, role tag, email, and service desk location; plus a BAA service-contact callout with WhatsApp Helpdesk and office hours. Layout rationale: trust and transparency — institutional leadership accountability, directory discoverability, and clear service escalation paths.
